name: Frost Fang
body:
Aura moderate evocation; Slot none; CL 11th; Weight 1 lb.; Price 36,002 gp

Alignment: LG
Ability Scores: Int 18 Wis 10 Cha 14; Ego 12
Languages: Aquan, Celestial, Common, Draconic, High Boros, telepathy

DESCRIPTION

This +1 frost dagger glows with a frosty blue light, and ice crystals form along the edge of the blade.

While wielding frost fang you are immune to cold damage. In addition, you may cast snowball from the dagger up to three times per day.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Feats Craft Magic Arms and Armor; Spells chill metal or ice storm, resist energy, snowball; Cost 18,001 gp
